name: agentpc
description: Disposable Windows and Ubuntu desktop VMs on Apple Silicon Macs for AI agents.
long_description: Create, screenshot, drive and reset local Windows 11 (ARM64) and Ubuntu (any release) desktop VMs over MCP. Requires QEMU from Homebrew (brew install qemu). Ubuntu images download on first use; Windows needs a one-time `agentpc image build windows`, which downloads the ISO from Microsoft.

tools.name: list_vms
tools.description: VMs (state, size, checkpoints) and which images exist

tools.name: create_vm
tools.description: Create a VM, optionally of a given OS version; ready in ~1 s (Ubuntu) or ~4 s (Windows)

tools.name: reset_vm
tools.description: Discard all changes: back to a fresh copy of the image

tools.name: checkpoint_vm
tools.description: Save a VM's disk and memory under a label

tools.name: restore_vm
tools.description: Put a VM back exactly as it was at a checkpoint (resumes in seconds)

tools.name: delete_vm
tools.description: Stop and delete an instance with its disk and checkpoints

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command (PowerShell on Windows, bash on Ubuntu); returns the exit code, stdout and stderr

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder from this Mac into a VM

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder from a VM to this Mac

tools.name: forward_port
tools.description: Reach a server running in a VM from this Mac

tools.name: list_desktop_tools
tools.description: List the desktop-control tools inside an instance

tools.name: use_desktop_tool
tools.description: Call a desktop-control tool inside an instance
